# SD13-E5 Ranger level 6 hybrid chassis baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Ranger level 6 identity as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and stays a single-class, level-6 hybrid baseline, mirroring the
# level-5 fixture's shape with the class level swapped.
#
# Level 6 adds one new deterministic choice selection tied to the PF1 Core Rulebook
# Combat Style Feat rule's 6th-level interval ("The ranger's expertise manifests in
# the form of bonus feats at 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th level."):
#   - choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_2 -> feat:manyshot (the SECOND combat
#     style bonus feat, drawn from the Archery style's own 6th-level restricted
#     list -- Improved Precise Shot or Manyshot -- since this fixture's combat
#     style, carried forward unchanged from level 2, is archery)
# This fixture carries forward the same favored-enemy (both types and the
# bonus-increase target), combat-style, favored-terrain, and hunter's-bond
# selections from the level-5 fixture unchanged, since none of those are
# re-granted at 6th level.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level6
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:6
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy:enemy:humanoid_orc
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_2:enemy:undead
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target:enemy:first
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style:style:archery
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat:feat:point_blank_shot
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat_2:feat:manyshot
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain:terrain:forest
choice=choice:ranger_hunters_bond:form:bond
